definitions.explanation: The act of making something smaller in size, scale, or scope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縮小|しゅくしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To reduce the size of an image.

examples.japanese: ⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縮小|しゅくしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A reduction in scale was announced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}→悪化：11077_akka⟧により、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縮小|しゅくしょう}せざる⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}なく→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the economic downturn, the company had no choice but to scale down its business.

notes:
{縮小|しゅくしょう} means to make something smaller, either physically or in terms of scope/scale.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {縮小|しゅくしょう}する (to reduce, shrink)
- 〜の{縮小|しゅくしょう} (reduction of ~)
- {縮小|しゅくしょう}{版|ばん} (reduced version)

USAGE CONTEXTS:
- Images/documents: {画像|がぞう}を{縮小|しゅくしょう}する
- Business: {事業|じぎょう}{縮小|しゅくしょう} (business downsizing)
- Economy: {市場|しじょう}の{縮小|しゅくしょう} (market contraction)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {拡大|かくだい}: enlargement, expansion (opposite)
- {削減|さくげん}: reduction, cutback (emphasis on cutting)
- {縮|ちぢ}める: to shrink (verb form)
